description: Mark that the worker arrived at a visit. The worker on the visit (or the office) can do this. Any on the way message not yet sent is dropped. When arrival notices are on, the customer gets one arrived text and one arrived email. Text is the main one. The email goes whenever the customer has an email address, even if the text does not. A do-not-email address is not emailed. Once only.
name: visits_arrived

customer_notice.description: Whether a customer notice was queued. On the way, that is the on the way message. Arrived, that is the arrived message when arrival notices are on. It is sent only if the customer can be reached.
